inputs.label: Rail Chase 2 arcade set (Revision A)
inputs.help: Your own Revision A rchase2.zip with all 23 files. Older 21-file sets are incomplete. Leave it zipped.

inputs.label: segabill.zip, only for a split set
inputs.help: Add segabill.zip only if your set is split. Leave it zipped.

steps.text: Open Rail Chase 2 - VR4ALL from Library > Unknown Sources and finish the ROM check on the setup screen.

notes: All releases are pre-releases. The releases also carry a PCVR zip and a source zip; the asset pattern takes only the Quest APK. No CHD is needed.
